response_item.revised_prompt: Using the attached approved street-corner game reference as visual authority, create a TWO-COMPONENT PAINTED SOURCE SHEET for its surveillance Camera. This is not the finished assembled object and not a scene. Left half: the COMPLETE charcoal cast-iron pole, including ball finial, collars, long cylindrical shaft and stepped round heavy base, with no bracket, no electronics box and no camera attached. Paint the entire pole surface uninterrupted including the areas normally hidden behind an attached bracket. Right half: the COMPLETE cream bracket and cream dome surveillance camera assembly, including vertical mounting plate, bent horizontal support, short neck, rounded cream hood and dark smoked lower hemisphere with tiny cyan status point; no pole, no extra objects. Both components separately isolated, fully uncropped, no overlap, same orthographic isometric view and matching scale for assembly. Match reference's chunky worn hand-painted outlines, strong left/top warm-grey rim highlights, dark charcoal side planes, subtly chipped rough cast metal and warm worn cream enamel. The pole must not be flat black, green, clean vector art, or a slender modern lamp. Maintain original substantial spherical finial and weighty flared stepped base. Dome and bracket must have convincing painted volume, not a white oval. Same top-left light. Raster painterly production source, not a 3D render or photo. High fidelity to reference silhouette and value structure. Large clean spacing between exactly TWO components. Transparent background with real alpha if supported; otherwise a completely flat pure magenta matte with no floor, no drop shadows, no checkerboard, no gradients or color bleeding. No text, labels or frames. 1024x1024. Complete component paintings are intended as independently editable raster layers; do not include a tiny assembled preview.
